record: Claude blind review of the Codex v0.2.0rc4 post-release verification draft

independent_evidence.note: The Claude verification was run before the Codex draft was read; this review compares the draft against that evidence and re-checks the points the draft asked about.

field_notes.classification: FAIL because B10 (recorded closed_verified) regressed inside the rc4 delta and nine other closed items retain reproducible residuals; equivalent to FAIL_NEW_REGRESSION in the Claude verification.
field_notes.runtime_regression_found: B10: the released rc4 wheel rejects every functional checkpoint written by the published rc1/rc2/rc3 releases on direct import and on explicit migrate_legacy_checkpoint (6/6). The same script succeeds at 1b15bf8. Regressing commits dc8c87a (Channel) and a195bd0 (Periodic). Fail-closed.
field_notes.scientific_or_numerical_failure_found: false for the qualified fresh-run paths (B1/B5/N1/B2/B25/B29 hold with rc1/rc3 negative controls). Robustness defects that affect scientific use are listed as new issues (Periodic NaN reported COMPLETE; legacy Channel silently resuming rc1 even-grid checkpoints).
field_notes.counts: Independent mapping onto the matrix states: closed_verified 28, partial_residual 9 (B7, B11, B13, B17, B20, B23, B24, N3, N6), regressed_after_closure 1 (B10), accepted_limitation 3 (B30, A2, A5; B30's documentation action is not done), deferred_architecture 9.
field_notes.release_mutation_recommended: Do not move the tag, rewrite the GitHub Release or publish to PyPI; fix in rc5 and record the regression in an evidence-only commit.

claims.claim: No new solver/numerical/Hermitian/pressure-adjoint regression in the declared scope
claims.evidence: B1 7500-step functional and 6000-step production runs, rc1 negative control; B5 independent collocation oracle with rc3 negative control; N1 dense adjoint identity 3.65e-16; B2/B25/B29 reproducers.
B10 regression reproduced on the installed release wheel with genuine rc1/rc2/rc3 checkpoints; control run at 1b15bf8 accepts rc3.

No regression versus rc3, but B11 is not closed: configuration/execution_device.py:86-93 restores a caller 'medium' precision as 'high'; tests/test_rc456_tf32_execution_scope.py:32-35 and benchmarks/qualify_rc458_tf32_scope.py:34-37 never construct a true 'medium' caller state.
See field_notes.counts; record-level closure was not re-tested against genuine released artifacts.
37/38 match matrix targets; A3 has target rc3 (closed_breaking_migration), not rc2 direct fix.

claims.claim: Historical fix commits are tag ancestors
claims.evidence: All cited fix commits pass git merge-base --is-ancestor <c> 6588694.

claims.claim: RC4.3 B8/B20/N4 closed by fail-closed public restriction
claims.evidence: B8 and N4: correct, physics unrepaired (models/active_nematics/stokes.py unchanged since v0.2.0rc2) and the internal lifted path stays executable. B20 is not a restriction closure: it is the explicit fresh-conditioning policy, and the rc432 strict contract ('reject incompatible fresh data') is not implemented (operators/lifting.py:397-398).
Behaviour matches; B30's recorded disposition 'document' was never carried out (operators/robin.py:306 docstring has no caveat; p852/p853/p855 tests still gate on it).
R2 partly centralized in io/checkpoint.py (still 10 implementations); R3 grew 5,153 -> 7,369 lines; R6 grew 2,626 -> 2,819 lines plus 1,443 lines of publicly unreachable lifting infrastructure.

Independent venv: pip check PASS, site-packages imports only; Periodic (both storages) and Channel 4-step runs, 2+2 restart byte-identical; PSSolver suite against the wheel 3146 passed with all 260 failures attributable to source-path/git harness; PSSolver-Control b8539e0 310 passed / 1 skipped against the rc4 wheel.
